title: Cooney lesh My Quiet Bible
description: Ta My Quiet Bible nastee son dy chooilley pheiagh, dy bragh. My t’ee cooney lhiat, foddee oo cooney lesh freayll y lampey soilshean.
sub: Nastee son dy chooilley pheiagh, dy bragh. My t’ee cooney lhiat, foddee oo cooney lesh freayll y lampey soilshean.
kofiSub: Un cheayrt, ny dagh mee. Lesh kaart, Apple Pay ny Google Pay, gyn feme er screeu dty ennym.
leave: T’eh fosley ayns duillag noa. Tar back ayns shoh, ny gys y Vible, tra t’ou jeant.
btcSub: On-chain ny Lightning, kiart gys y serveyr ain hene, gyn mean-ghooinney ny trass pheiagh.
where:
• Ny serveyryn ta freayll sync as kiarkylyn gobbraghey.
  • Ny enmyn-reeriaght, dy vod myquietbible.com freayll gobbraghey.
  • Yn post-L ta cur coadyn goll stiagh.
never: Cha bee veg ayns y Vible glast rieau. Ta cur myr gura mie ayd, cha nee tiggad stiagh, as cha nel veg caghlaa ayns yn app my t’ou cur ny dyn.
tax: Cha nel My Quiet Bible ny carrys recortit, myr shen cha nel ny gioottyn giarrey sheese yn keesh.
other:
• Guee son yn obbyr shoh, as son y sleih ta lhaih lhee.
  • Cur myquietbible.com da peiagh baillish Bible kiune.
